plugins.description: Confluence Cloud: space pages as a knowledge source, CQL search tool, create/update page output node

plugins.description: Jenkins: run a job as a verification step, start a task from a failed build, read console logs

plugins.description: SonarQube (self-hosted): quality gate and open issues as workflow steps and agent tools
